## What does this PR do?

## Type of change

- [ ] New paper note (`papers/*.md`)
- [ ] Taxonomy update (`taxonomy/*.md`)
- [ ] Survey draft (`surveys/drafts/*.md`)
- [ ] Documentation / framing (`docs/*.md`, `*.md` at root)
- [ ] Tooling / templates / CI
- [ ] Other (describe)

## Paper note checklist (if applicable)

- [ ] File starts from `papers/_template.md`.
- [ ] All required fields filled or marked `N/A` with an explanation.
- [ ] Citation added to `references/bibliography.bib`.
- [ ] Paper registered in `papers/INDEX.md` under the right status.
- [ ] Paper cross-linked from the relevant `taxonomy/*.md` pages.
- [ ] Filename follows `papers/<first-author-year-keyword>.md`.

## Reviewers needed

- [ ] One approving review (default for paper notes)
- [ ] Two approving reviews (required for taxonomy / outline / research-questions)

## Source verification

- [ ] Every factual claim about the paper has been checked against the
      primary source.
- [ ] No invented numbers, screenshots, or quotes.
- [ ] If an AI assistant drafted this content, a human reviewer has
      cross-checked it.
